contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban streets with small tiled building walls, shop windows, canvas awnings, potted plants, parked scooters and brick or stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; white reflective details catch the direct flash; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: No hand-held prop; the shutter, tiled wall and street are the setting. The raised hand holds the pale gray cap, and its front is conservatively reconstructed. The navy jacket sleeves are pushed up in the editorial; the product shows the full long sleeve, reconstructed, with its back and hidden front inferred. The white tee is a separate product. The black shorts and charcoal tights are separate products. Brand, fibre composition, performance and retail identity are unknown.

deck.ko: 네이비 긴소매 재킷과 흰 티의 열린 면.
deck.en: A navy long-sleeve jacket opens over white.
deck.de: Eine marineblaue Langarmjacke öffnet sich über Weiß.

intro.ko: 갑작스러운 바람에 모자를 잡으며 한 걸음 방향을 바꿉니다.
intro.en: A sudden gust lifts the cap as he changes direction for one step.
intro.de: Eine Böe hebt das Cap, während er mit einem Schritt die Richtung ändert.

body.ko: 팔을 올리자 네이비 재킷의 긴소매가 주름지고 흰 반팔 이너가 앞면을 밝힙니다. 검정 쇼츠와 차콜 타이츠는 각각의 길이를 유지하고 검정 양말과 흰 창 러닝화가 이어집니다. 옅은 회색 캡과 흰 어깨·소매 반사선이 직접 플래시에 선명해집니다.
body.en: The raised arm folds the long navy sleeve, revealing a separate white tee at the front. Black shorts and charcoal tights hold their own lengths above black socks and white-soled runners. Pale gray cap and white shoulder and sleeve lines catch direct flash.
body.de: Der gehobene Arm faltet den langen Marineärmel; vorne zeigt sich ein separates weißes Shirt. Schwarze Shorts und Anthrazittight behalten eigene Längen über schwarzen Socken und weiß besohlten Laufschuhen. Hellgraues Cap und weiße Schulter- und Ärmellinien fangen direkten Blitz.

pull.en: White reflective lines follow the moving arm.
pull.de: Weiße Reflexlinien folgen dem bewegten Arm.

copy.pullQuoteEn: White reflective lines follow the moving arm.

tip.ko: 바람이 잦아들면 모자 깊이와 올린 재킷 커프를 다시 맞추세요.
tip.en: Reset the cap depth and raised jacket cuffs after the gust.
tip.de: Nach der Böe die Captiefe und hochgeschobenen Jackenbündchen neu einstellen.
